scope: Independent image-only capture correctness, not feature acceptance or implementation review
retry_context: Coordinator reports same script/arguments with engine --fixed-fps 60; this review does not infer script or engine causes from images.
inspection_method: Opened every one of the 17 individual PNGs using view_image. No source changes or implementation inspection.
identity_note: Tess / level 54 / Mirejaw is established by readable HUD. Human trainer identity cannot be independently confirmed from appearance. Frame pass evaluates readable active/opponent creatures for the named HUD encounter.

persistent_failures.detail: Initial and later frames still collapse into mesh surfaces or a terrain wall. Fixed-FPS retry did not remove the visual failure class.
Mirejaw absent at 16 seconds and heavily cropped at 24/48; readable encounter HUD does not supply missing fight view.

All three pairs display legible incoming text. Their magenta ground cue is mostly hidden by creature overlap and grass; first pair also has substantial cropping. Final pair retains opponent better than original run, but does not resolve spatial tell readability.
No capture directory/PNG for Calder, Venn or Nerissa; only Tess/Mirejaw first-opponent sequence is visually evidenced.
Ability panel visibly uses mouse icons and F/C keys throughout, not controller glyphs.

lighting_and_assets: Unobstructed early frames are brightly lit and primary HUD is readable. Team panel often fades to low contrast. Visible creatures and humans are detailed textured meshes, with no obvious primitive creature placeholders; hidden objects cannot be verified. Magenta geometry appears with attack warnings but stills cannot determine asset provenance.
